test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following graph shows the production of cotton cloth (in lakh meters) by three companies A, B, and C over the years. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1f765b5013ebfb64cffb74f1aacc72b7d194fa4274f2b6bc049a78fc4a2b9b9.png] 

In which years the production of company C is 81.94% (correct to 2 decimal places) of the combined production of company A and company B?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The combined production of company A and company B in 1996 = (24 + 22) = 46

The production of C in 1996 = 40

The percentage in 1996 = (46 × 81.94)/100 

⇒ 3769.24/100

⇒ 37.69

It is not equal to the production of C

Now,

The combined production of company A and company B in 1997 = (29 + 23) = 52

The production of C in 1997 = 62

The percentage in 1997 = (52 × 81.94)/100

⇒ 4260.88/100

⇒ 42.60

It is not equal to the production of C

Now,

The combined production of company A and company B in 1998 = (34 + 38) = 72

The production of C in 1998 = 59

The percentage in 1998 = (72 × 81.94)/100

⇒ 5899.68/100

⇒ 58.99 ~ 59

It is equal to the production of C

Now,

The combined production of company A and company B in 1999 = (57 + 49) = 106

The production of C in 1999 = 51

The percentage in 1999 = (106 × 81.94)/100

⇒ 8685.64/100

⇒ 86.85

It is not equal to the production of C

Now,

The combined production of company A and company B in 2000 = (45 + 55) = 100

The production of C in 2000 = 52

The percentage in 2000 = (100 × 81.94)/100

⇒ 8194/100

⇒ 81.94

It is not equal to the production of C

**∴ The production of company C is 81.94% (correct to 2 decimal places) of the combined production of company A and company B in the year 1998**
